Same series name, different SKU, different hardware. W03082 and W03083 are one retail pairing but the vendor page for W03082 states recoil and electric start and no remote start, while the retailer claims a fob on W03083. Not a contradiction, but proof that the series name predicts nothing — do not carry a finding side
W03082 is advertised 'parallel ready'. A parallel kit port is a power-sync connector between two generators, not a data port. Do not mistake it for a bus.
